name: stock help
author: LizardMan
description: The OP-1's own help screen is back, on FN held alone or pressed twice, by the setting "tap". Single: hold FN for the hold time (300 ms to start). Double: press FN twice, and the help shows at once while the second press is held. Any other key or a turn hides it first, so FN's combinations never show it, and shift + FN opens the date and time. Without this plugin the help costs no memory. It shares FN held with the monitor: keep one of the two switched on.
